title: Juniper security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-032.081017: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Juniper Security Updates
leadParagraph: Juniper Networks has released a security advisory for Junos OS stating that an integer signedness vulnerability exists in libgd 2.1.1 which may result in a heap overflow when processing compressed gd2 data.
contentHtml:
Juniper Networks has released a security advisory for Junos OS stating that an integer signedness vulnerability exists in libgd 2.1.1 which may result in a heap overflow when processing compressed gd2 data.

Further information on this vulnerability and how it can be fixed can be found on the Juniper Website at https://kb.juniper.net/InfoCenter/index?page=content&id=JSA10798&cat=SIRT_1&actp=LIST
